Paying without insurance

No insurance? A standard primary care visit is $145 for self-pay patients, and we offer interest-free payment plans.

New to Harbor Lane?

  1. Request an appointmentBook online or call the clinic. Tell us if you're transferring from another practice.
  2. Complete your formsWe'll send a portal invitation by email with health history and consent forms.
  3. Bring ID and your insurance cardArrive 15 minutes early for your first visit so we can scan your documents.
  4. Meet your care teamYour clinician reviews your history and agrees a care plan with you.
Request your first visit

Common questions

Do you take walk-ins?
Lab draws are walk-in during lab hours. For sick visits, book online; same-day slots open at 7:00 AM each weekday.
Can I see the same clinician every time?
Yes. You choose a primary care clinician and we book you with them whenever they're available.
Do you offer video visits?
Many follow-ups, behavioral health sessions and minor concerns can be handled by video. The booking form shows which visit types each service offers.
How do I cancel or move an appointment?
Use the link in your confirmation email or call the clinic. Please give 24 hours' notice so someone else can take the slot.
